args.message:
Bump fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson <2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion
when parsing deeply nested arrays). Upgrade to the fixed 2.9.4 release.

args.body:
This upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to address CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Versions <2.9.4 are affected; 2.9.4 contains the fix (a minimal patch bump within the same major version).

- Changed: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` in requirements.txt
- CI has passed on branch `bump-fastjson-2.9.4` (run ci-0001)
args.head: bump-fastjson-2.9.4
